invoice_tpl.fields_hint: Put these between double braces in your Word template. A field that does not exist stays visible, so you can see a typo.

One table row with {{regel.omschrijving}}, {{regel.aantal}}, {{regel.prijs}} and {{regel.totaal}} is repeated for every line of the order. You always get a PDF back: the app turns the Word file into one with LibreOffice.

notify.check: Check connection to the push services

notify.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser or device settings and come back.
notify.ios_install: Notifications on iPhone and iPad only work for an installed app (iOS 16.4 or newer): add the app to your home screen first.

You get one notification as soon as the total drops below the threshold; another follows only once it has been back above it in between.
